summary: Iteration 2 full regression of Clearspace PWA (backend + frontend + cross-device sync). All 5 pytest backend checks pass (ping, progress merge semantics with counter-max + union of achievements + per-day history max + platform accumulation, GET 404, pair create+single-use redeem, invalid code 404). All 10 frontend flows requested in the review pass: fresh Home (hero '0' / MB / level '01' / 7 recap mini-bars / 0/13 trophies), review start -> try-sample loads 12 photos with '0 / 12' label, remove/keep/favorite advance stack, undo reverts, review-queue + confirm-remove-btn now correctly returns to Home (iteration-1 blocker is fixed) with stats incremented (hero 4.8 MB, cleared 4), Burst Buster toast fires after 4 decisions on the first set, First Clear toast fires exactly once after confirming removal (no duplicates for same achievement across return-to-home), Weekly Recap card shows bytes/range/cleared/streak/top-trophy and share-recap-btn triggers headless download fallback ('Saved recap image to downloads.'), recap-back-btn returns Home, Settings sync-panel shows sync-device-id, sync-now-btn produces 'Progress synced.' and platform-chip-web becomes active, get-link-code-btn produces a 6-char code, auto-sync-toggle toggles and home-sync-indicator ('Synced') shows on Home, Achievements grid renders 13 tiles, reset-progress-btn with accepted confirm resets Home to 0. Cross-device link verified in a fresh browser context: pair code from a seeded first device (50 MB, 7 cleared) was entered via link-code-input, link-device-btn produced 'Linked. Progress merged across devices.', sync-device-id updated to the first device id, and Home hero updated to 50.0 MB (max of both).
critical_code_review_comments: shareCard.js uses document.fonts?.ready — safe, but headless browsers may render recap PNG with fallback fonts; acceptable fallback behavior.

server.py merge() mutates existing dict via out = {**existing, ...}; harmless since existing is a dict from Mongo fetch, but platforms accumulation lives in the endpoint (not merge()), which is slightly inconsistent — consider moving platforms into merge() for symmetry.
pair code uses secrets but excludes O/I only on uppercase; the digits set includes '0' via the trailing '23456789' string (good) but keep this in mind if alphabet is tweaked.
App.js auto-sync effect depends on `syncKey` (a derived string) and `state.autoSync`; eslint-react-hooks may warn about missing deps — currently uses a ref to avoid loops which is fine.
storage.js resetState generates a new deviceId, which effectively unlinks the device from any paired progress on the backend; this is the intended behavior but is worth documenting in the UI.
seed_data_creation: Backend seeded one TEST_dev_firstctx_* progress doc (50 MB freed, 7 cleared) and one single-use pair code for cross-device link verification. Pair code consumed during test. Progress doc remains in db (TEST_ prefix) and can be purged by main agent if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_clearspace_backend.py uses REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend flows exercised via Playwright at viewport 600x1024 (spec needs >=500 wide). Iteration-1 blocker (Home not re-rendering after confirm-remove-btn) is now resolved — root cause was AnimatePresence mode=wait on page transitions, now using a plain motion.div keyed by screen in App.js. Toasts are derived from state.unlocked diff via a Set in a ref (seenUnlocked), which prevents duplicate toasts across re-renders; this works correctly end-to-end. Cross-device link flow depends on backend /api/pair being single-use — confirmed.
